supportRetentionProposal.status: Operational policy accepted explicitly by publisher on 2026-10-22; mailbox implementation and legal review not verified
supportRetentionProposal.exceptions: Keep only records still needed for an identified legal/security purpose, with a reason and review date recorded. Delete earlier if no longer necessary.
supportRetentionProposal.process: Publisher to implement a review/deletion schedule that meets the 90-day deadline, record necessary exceptions and review dates, and delete earlier when no longer needed. No mailbox changes made.
supportRetentionProposal.proposedNotice: Resolved support correspondence is normally deleted within 90 days after resolution, or sooner when no longer needed. A record may be kept longer only for an identified legal or security purpose, with a documented review date.
supportRetentionProposal.sourceLimit: 90 days is a proposed business retention period, not a duration prescribed by the ICO.
implementationChecklist: Assign publisher responsibility for support and privacy requests.
At resolution, record a case reference, resolution date and deletion deadline no later than 90 days afterward; avoid duplicating email content in the log.
Review at least monthly and delete messages due before the next scheduled review, so the 90-day limit is not exceeded.
Retain only necessary records under a documented legal/security exception with a review date; reassess requests for earlier deletion.
Apply the policy to sent replies, attachments, exports and provider trash/backup behaviour as applicable; verify what the mail provider supports.
